components.name: Primary Command Button
components.description: The single committed action in a compact control group.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display:inline-flex; min-height:44px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; border:0; border-radius:4px; background:var(--red, #E45445); color:#fff; padding:0 18px; font-family:'Noto Sans SC',sans-serif; font-size:13px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:0; box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(133,45,38,.26); transition:filter 160ms ease-out,transform 160ms ease-out; } .ds-button-primary:hover { filter:brightness(1.06); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus, #B9E5D1); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform:translateY(1px); } .ds-button-primary:disabled { background:#383A35; color:#777970; box-shadow:none; }

components.name: Square Icon Tool
components.description: A fixed square for familiar room and station tools.
components.html: <button class="ds-icon-tool" type="button" aria-label="创建牌局"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-icon-tool { display:grid; width:38px; height:38px; place-items:center; border:1px solid var(--line, #3B3C37); border-radius:4px; background:var(--panel, #1D1E1B); color:var(--bone, #F2EFE8); padding:0; transition:background 160ms ease-out,border-color 160ms ease-out,color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-icon-tool svg { width:18px; height:18px; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:1.8; stroke-linecap:round; } .ds-icon-tool:hover { border-color:var(--mint, #73C6A0); background:#26342E; color:var(--mint, #73C6A0); } .ds-icon-tool:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus, #B9E5D1); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-icon-tool:active { background:#1B2B24; }

components.name: Recessed Text Field
components.description: The standard dark field for room codes, search, and operational reasons.
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:8px; color:var(--muted, #AAA89F); font-family:'Noto Sans SC',sans-serif; font-size:11px; letter-spacing:0; } .ds-field input { width:260px; min-height:46px; border:1px solid var(--line, #3B3C37); border-radius:4px; background:#151613; color:var(--bone, #F2EFE8); padding:0 13px; font:400 14px/1.4 'Noto Sans SC',sans-serif; caret-color:var(--mint, #73C6A0); transition:border-color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color:#76786F; opacity:1; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color:#5E6059; } .ds-field input:focus { border-color:var(--mint, #73C6A0); outline:1px solid var(--mint, #73C6A0); outline-offset:0; }

components.name: Station Navigation
components.description: The RF station mark and compact active-route grammar shared by operational headers.
components.html: RFRoyal Flush牌局记录服务已连接
components.css: .ds-station-nav { display:flex; width:100%; min-height:68px; align-items:center; gap:8px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line, #3B3C37); background:var(--ink-raised, #161714); color:var(--bone, #F2EFE8); padding:0 28px; font-family:'Noto Sans SC',sans-serif; letter-spacing:0; } .ds-station-mark { display:grid; width:38px; height:38px; place-items:center; border:2px solid currentColor; margin-right:4px; font:800 13px/1 Arial,sans-serif; } .ds-station-nav strong { margin-right:22px; font-size:14px; } .ds-station-nav a { position:relative; align-self:stretch; display:flex; align-items:center; color:var(--muted, #AAA89F); padding:0 14px; font-size:12px; text-decoration:none; } .ds-station-nav a:hover { color:var(--bone, #F2EFE8); } .ds-station-nav a:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus, #B9E5D1); outline-offset:-3px; } .ds-station-nav a.ds-active { color:var(--bone, #F2EFE8); } .ds-station-nav a.ds-active::after { position:absolute; right:14px; bottom:-1px; left:14px; height:2px; background:var(--red, #E45445); content:''; } .ds-service { margin-left:auto; color:var(--mint, #73C6A0); font-size:11px; }

components.name: System Broadcast
components.description: A persistent authoritative event strip, not a floating alert card.
components.html: 桌内广播岱奇新增 1,000 局外积分23:48:12
components.css: .ds-system-broadcast { display:grid; grid-template-columns:112px 1fr auto; min-height:44px; align-items:center; gap:12px; border-bottom:1px solid #4B332F; background:#271C19; color:#E8D1CB; padding:0 28px; font-family:'Noto Sans SC',sans-serif; font-size:11px; letter-spacing:0; } .ds-system-broadcast strong { color:var(--red, #E45445); font-size:10px; } .ds-system-broadcast time { color:#947B75; font:600 11px/1 'Barlow Condensed','Arial Narrow',sans-serif; } .ds-system-broadcast:focus-within { outline:2px solid var(--focus, #B9E5D1); outline-offset:-3px; }

components.name: Speaking Player Station
components.description: A stable dual-score station with an explicit mint speaking state.
components.html:
DC岱奇
牌桌分1,240局外积分980
components.css: .ds-player-station { width:152px; min-height:64px; border:1px solid #4C4E48; border-radius:6px; background:#1B1C19; color:var(--bone, #F2EFE8); box-shadow:0 8px 22px rgba(0,0,0,.3); padding:8px 9px; font-family:'Noto Sans SC',sans-serif; letter-spacing:0; } .ds-player-station.ds-speaking { border-color:var(--mint, #73C6A0); } .ds-player-station header { display:grid; grid-template-columns:24px 1fr auto; align-items:center; gap:7px; } .ds-player-station header>strong { overflow:hidden; font-size:11px; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-avatar { display:grid; width:24px; height:24px; place-items:center; border-radius:50%; background:#33352F; font-size:9px; } .ds-player-station>div { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:8px; margin-top:7px; } .ds-player-station>div>span { color:#B5B3AA; font-size:9px; } .ds-player-station>div strong { display:block; margin-top:2px; color:var(--bone, #F2EFE8); font:600 14px/1 'Barlow Condensed','Arial Narrow',sans-serif; } .ds-meter { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:2px; color:var(--mint, #73C6A0); } .ds-meter i { display:block; width:2px; height:7px; background:currentColor; } .ds-meter i:nth-child(2) { height:14px; } .ds-meter i:nth-child(3) { height:10px; } .ds-player-station:focus-within { outline:2px solid var(--focus, #B9E5D1); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Physical Chip Button
components.description: A repeatable denomination control with physical rings and short travel.
components.html: <button class="ds-physical-chip" type="button" aria-label="增加 20 牌桌分">20</button>
components.css: .ds-physical-chip { display:grid; width:52px; height:52px; place-items:center; border:4px dashed rgba(242,239,232,.73); border-radius:50%; background:#9D493F; color:#fff; box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 3px #9D493F,inset 0 0 0 5px rgba(255,255,255,.14),0 6px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.28); padding:0; font:700 13px/1 'Barlow Condensed','Arial Narrow',sans-serif; letter-spacing:0; transition:transform 140ms ease-out,filter 140ms ease-out; } .ds-physical-chip:hover:not(:disabled) { transform:translateY(-3px); filter:brightness(1.1); } .ds-physical-chip:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus, #B9E5D1); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-physical-chip:active:not(:disabled) { transform:translateY(0); } .ds-physical-chip:disabled { opacity:.27; }

components.name: Face-up Playing Card
components.description: A bone-white semantic rank-and-suit card; red suits use shape and color together.
components.css: .ds-playing-card { position:relative; display:block; width:54px; height:74px; border-radius:5px; background:var(--bone, #F2EFE8); color:#171815; box-shadow:0 7px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.22); padding:7px; font:700 16px/1 Arial,sans-serif; letter-spacing:0; } .ds-playing-card.ds-red { color:#BE4439; } .ds-playing-card>span { position:absolute; right:7px; bottom:7px; font-size:18px; } .ds-playing-card:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus, #B9E5D1); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Operations Metric
components.description: A dense admin summary cell that reads as part of one equipment band.
components.css: .ds-operations-metric { width:220px; min-height:118px; border:1px solid var(--line, #3B3C37); background:var(--panel, #1D1E1B); color:var(--bone, #F2EFE8); padding:20px; font-family:'Noto Sans SC',sans-serif; letter-spacing:0; } .ds-operations-metric>span { color:var(--muted, #AAA89F); font-size:11px; } .ds-operations-metric>strong { display:block; margin-top:9px; font:600 31px/.9 'Barlow Condensed','Arial Narrow',sans-serif; } .ds-operations-metric>small { display:block; margin-top:15px; color:var(--mint, #73C6A0); font-size:11px; } .ds-operations-metric:hover { background:var(--panel-raised, #252622); } .ds-operations-metric:focus-within { outline:2px solid var(--focus, #B9E5D1); outline-offset:-3px; }

narrative.overview:
Royal Flush behaves like a calm event scorekeeper sharing a desk with a warm late-night radio host. A private poker room is presented as a live score broadcast: operational, quiet, precise, and social, with no casino glamour and no suggestion of money or prizes.

Warm graphite equipment, bone-white cards, vermilion action signals, mint voice activity, and amber waiting states make the interface feel like one coherent station. The player application and the operations console share the same restrained materials, compact controls, precise scoring figures, and visible system state; expression comes from those instruments rather than decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Warm graphite equipment surfaces separated by one-pixel seams.
Bone-white information and cards, with color reserved for operational signals.
Condensed measurement numerals paired with highly legible Chinese interface copy.
Compact square tools, restrained rectangular commands, circular physical chips, and one signature oval table.
Dense, stable layouts built for repeated action and authoritative scanning.

rules.name: The Signal, Never Wash Rule
rules.body: Vermilion means committed or urgent action, mint means voice, connection, or success, and amber means waiting or caution; none of them becomes a decorative page tint.

rules.name: The Measurement Voice Rule
rules.body: Use Barlow Condensed only for quantities and compact identifiers; all commands, names, statuses, and Chinese prose remain in Noto Sans SC.

rules.name: The Operational Density Rule
rules.body: Preserve scan paths, fixed control tracks, and stable dimensions before adding whitespace; this is a repeated-use score desk, not a marketing composition.

rules.name: The Downward Weight Rule
rules.body: Shadows must read as physical weight beneath equipment; never replace them with colored glow, neon haze, or a border-plus-halo decoration.

rules.name: The Oval Exception Rule
rules.body: Large curvature belongs to the poker table and genuinely circular instruments; do not turn containers, navigation, commands, or status labels into pills.

rules.name: The Stable Command Rule
rules.body: Preserve the dimensions and order of score, chip, voice, timer, and legal-action controls across state changes so urgency never causes layout shift.

dos: Do use Warm Graphite as the ground and layer equipment with tonal steps, one-pixel seams, and restrained downward shadows.
Do reserve Action Vermilion for committed or urgent action, Voice Mint for voice, connection, or success, and Waiting Amber for waiting or caution.
Do use Noto Sans SC for Chinese interface copy and Barlow Condensed for points, stakes, bets, hand numbers, countdowns, timestamps, and other measurements.
Do keep controls compact, tactile, keyboard-visible, and dimensionally stable across loading, reconnecting, disabled, success, and error states.
Do pair every color signal with shape, icon, text, border, position, or opacity, and honor reduced-motion preferences.
donts: Don't introduce black-and-gold casino styling, green felt, chip-pile decoration, crowns, Las Vegas photography, neon haze, or gambling and money metaphors.
Don't use decorative cards as page scaffolds, nest cards inside cards, or float every section in a rounded container.
Don't turn controls, navigation, or status labels into a pill-heavy interface; reserve circles and the large oval for physical instruments and the table.
Don't use colored glow, blur, or halo as elevation; depth comes from tonal contrast, seams, and broad black shadows with visible offset.
Don't let voice, animation, decorative imagery, or responsive compression obscure authoritative game state or block legal play.
